$comment: Ratchet baseline for check-email-send-gated.mjs. Each key is an UNGATED sendEmail/sendBatchEmails call site (<file>:<line>) that is NOT preceded by an isSuppressed()/isSuppressedByEmail() check in its function. The list may only SHRINK. To clear an entry: gate the send and remove the line, then run node scripts/check-email-send-gated.mjs --write. NEVER add a new entry to silence a new lead send, gate it instead. kind=internal: a genuinely-internal or 1:1 transactional send (broker alert, admin notice, the broker's own digest, an e-signature notification to a transaction party) with no marketable lead recipient to suppress; permanently allowlisted. kind=lead-todo is NO LONGER ALLOWED: every lead/client-facing marketing send is now gated through the suppression chokepoint, and the runner asserts only kind=internal entries remain.
